name: line-cua-mcp
description: macOS LINE Desktop MCP server: background chat-history reads from the local encrypted DB, plus cursor-free UI sends via cua-driver.
author: Dawson

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && /usr/bin/swiftc -O src/ocr.swift -o dist/ocr && cp src/linedb.py dist/linedb.py
scripts.test: yarn build && node test/matcher.test.mjs && node test/files.test.mjs && node test/helper.test.mjs && node test/linedb.test.mjs && node test/attachments.test.mjs && node test/search.test.mjs && node test/ocr.test.mjs && python3 test/download-target.test.py
